news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.5% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Aki India Limited Announces Appointments and Resignations of Non-Executive and Independent Directors and Reconstitution of Board Committees, Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: AKI India Limited appointed Mrs. Sarika Agarwal as an Additional Non-Executive and Independent Director of the Company with effect from January 9, 2026. Mrs. Sarika Agarwal holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree from Allahabad University (1998) and is an experienced entrepreneur and is actively engaged in running her own business at Mirzapur, bringing practical business insight and commercial acumen to the Board. AKI India Limited appointed Mr. Abdul Rashid Khan as an Additional Non-Executive and Independent Director of the Company with effect from January 9, 2026. Mr. Abdul Rashid Khan holds a Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com., 2008) and a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B., 2011).
